candidates: In Vue template strings (in stories, decorators, and documentation snippets), use v-bind shorthand syntax (`:attr="expression"`) for dynamic HTML attribute bindings. Mustache interpolation (`{{ }}`) is only valid for text content — writing `attr={{expression}}` inside a tag will render literally as text instead of being evaluated as a binding.

In Storybook Vue decorator implementations, do not use `inject: [...]` to access values that are already passed as decorator context parameters (e.g. `globals`, `args`). No corresponding `provide` is called for these values, so injecting them will trigger Vue 3 dev warnings ('injection not found'). Use the context parameter directly in `setup()` instead.
